question: After catalog failures are contained, should exact, already-active `workspace-directory` plugins become an officially supported native Codex plugin source?
rationale: This intentionally expands the curated-only organization-plugin trust boundary established by prior merged history and carries protected product/security review signals.

options.title: Approve narrow fail-closed support
options.body: Admit only exact configured active workspace plugins while keeping catalog failures plugin-local and retaining existing ownership and approval controls.

options.title: Retain curated-only boundary
options.body: Keep organization workspace plugins outside OpenClaw's native Codex plugin policy pipeline.

recommendation.title: Approve narrow fail-closed support
recommendation.body: Admit only exact configured active workspace plugins while keeping catalog failures plugin-local and retaining existing ownership and approval controls.
